blocked_python_build_inputs.name: pyyaml-final
blocked_python_build_inputs.issue: Select and pin pure-Python or C-extension/Cython backend and Python/packaging closure.

required_acceptance: Independently review original archive/source member copyright notices and complete component attribution for all selected built inputs.
Verify source-built compiler/CMake/Ninja/Meson/pkgconf/Python dependencies without fallback to distribution host libraries.
Native configure/compile with exact Mesa source options and LLVM 21.1.6 X86 shared ABI including RTTI; validate no auto fallback.
Record deterministic DESTDIR installed-path inventory and ELF NEEDED/RPATH/RUNPATH for libLLVM, GLX/Mesa, libdrm, libxshmfence, libXxf86vm and demo utilities.
Bind immutable software application artifact/view and compatible rootfs references; no Basic rootfs or /dev/dri expansion.
On modest CPU TurboVNC/Xvnc noVNC Workspace, show Zog-built glxgears briefly animated, no server/client crash, optional glxinfo -B showing llvmpipe; no FPS gate.
forbidden_promotions: No canonical monthly pin until above evidence
No automatic Host native compilation submission
No performance soak or high-core benchmark
